question.text:
Which of the following statements is/are true?
1.$\mathrm{PH}_{5}$ and $\mathrm{BiCl}_{5}$ do not exist.
2.$p \pi-d \pi$ bond is present in $\mathrm{SO}_{2}$
3.$\mathrm{I}_{3}^{+}$ has bent geometry.
4.$\mathrm{SeF}_{4}$ and $\mathrm{CH}_{4}$, have same shape.

solution.text: All the three statements are correct.
